name: article-quality-editor
title_zh: 总编视角通读一遍，给出可执行的发表前修改清单
tagline_zh: 别让 AI 腔、事实风险和冗余段落溜进终稿。它像总编一样逐段审，按严重度排序给你改单，连哪句像 AI 写的都标出来。
tagline_en: Stop AI-sounding lines, factual risks, and flab from reaching your final draft. It reviews paragraph by paragraph.
desc_en: Review completed article drafts from an editor-in-chief perspective and produce a prioritized, actionable publication-readiness report. Use when the user asks to proofread, critique, audit, or improve an article for factual risk, AI-like phrasing, redundancy, missing explanation, heading structure, reader clarity, depth of analysis, unnatural SEO language, deletion candidates, or human verificatio
why_zh: 不是挑错别字，而是按发表标准拆解：事实风险、AI 腔、冗余、结构、解释缺口。
why_en: Not a typo checker—it audits against publication standards: factual risk, AI phrasing, redundancy, structure, missing.
limit_zh: 只审已成稿的完整文章，不处理大纲、碎片或非中文内容；不自动改写，只给定位到句的修改建议；事实核查依赖原文可验证性。
limit_en: Only full article drafts; no outlines, fragments, or non-Chinese text. It flags and suggests, never rewrites. Fact-checking is limited to claims.
title_en: Editor-in-chief pass that returns a prioritized.
